name: fsq-spatial-desktop
description: Install, launch, and connect FSQ Spatial Desktop so this agent can drive its geospatial tools (DuckDB SQL, Kepler.gl maps, H3 Hub datasets) over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Drive FSQ Spatial Desktop: SQL, maps, H3 Hub
interface.longDescription: Connect this agent to a running FSQ Spatial Desktop app. The plugin registers the app's MCP server as a local command, so the tools are the app's own — DuckDB SQL over the project's data, Kepler.gl and deck.gl maps written into a document, and H3 Hub datasets — and ships the bootstrap skill that installs and launches the app when it is not running.
defaultPrompt: Get the population distribution of Los Angeles
Map nighttime lights over Ukraine by year
Which H3 Hub datasets cover crime in Los Angeles County?
